text:
Hakata Station has two sides, a ramen floor by the Shinkansen gates and a shrine on the roof. 5 things worth knowing before your train pulls into Fukuoka 👇

1️⃣ Two exits, two worlds. The Hakata exit faces the city: the bus terminal is a minute away and Canal City about 10 minutes on foot. The Chikushi exit is the quieter side, with Yodobashi right outside and rows of business hotels.

2️⃣ The airport is underground. Don't go out at all: the subway Airport Line takes about 5 minutes and ¥260 to Fukuoka Airport, two stops. Tenjin is about 5 minutes the other way.

3️⃣ A whole floor of ramen. Hakata Men Kaido on DEITOS 2F, next to the Shinkansen gates, serves as late as 23:30.

4️⃣ Mentaiko, side by side. In the Hakata Hankyu food hall (B1), the big mentaiko makers sit next to each other, so you can compare before you buy. It's closed on 1 January.

5️⃣ Bags can travel without you. The cashless Multi E-Cube lockers on the Hakata side deliver to Fukuoka hotels the same day if you book by 9:30 and drop the bag by 11:00.

✨ And a bonus: the rooftop garden of JR Hakata City, about 60 m up, has a small railway shrine for safe journeys. Open 10:00–22:00.
